## 回答 B
最終答案: 15.29
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層「取消率」定義：已取消訂單（status=9）÷（有效訂單 status 1/2/3 + 已取消訂單），不含待付款（status=0）。期間以訂單成立時間 order_ts 轉為台北時間（UTC+8）後的月份歸屬為 2025-11，共 695 筆已取消、3850 筆有效，合計 4545 筆。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_ts, status, typeof(order_ts) FROM orders LIMIT 20", "SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT order_ts, status, typeof(order_ts) FROM orders LIMIT 20', 'columns': ['order_ts', 'status', 'typeof(order_ts)'], 'rows': [['2025-05-27 02:32:55', 3, 'text'], ['2025-06-01 06:04:51', 3, 'text'], ['2025-09-27 08:46:07', 3, 'text'], ['2025-04-09 20:13:13', 3, 'text'], ['2025-12-31 14
SQL 2: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid, COUNT(*) AS total_in_scope, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11' AND status IN (1,2,3,9)
  結果: {'columns': ['cancelled', 'valid', 'total_in_scope', 'cancel_rate_pct'], 'rows': [[695, 3850, 4545, 15.29]], 'truncated': False}
